definitions.explanation: The act of looking through or reading documents, web pages, or other materials, typically in a formal or official context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閲覧|えつらん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閲覧|えつらん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of views on this page is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{古文書|こもんじょ}→古文書：15839_komonjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閲覧|えつらん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At the library, you can view rare historical documents.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used in written and official contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at) or ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) is more natural. {閲覧|えつらん} is commonly used in digital contexts ({閲覧|えつらん}⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧ = browsing history) and for accessing official records.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閲覧|えつらん}⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧: browsing history
- {閲覧|えつらん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: view count, page views
- {閲覧|えつらん}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: viewing restriction
- {閲覧|えつらん}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: viewer discretion advised
- {閲覧|えつらん}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: available for viewing
